purpose: Quantization degradation: compare correctness, strict format, and question-level failure changes; preserve emitted reasoning for later analysis.

exam.order: original file order; identical for every quantization
exam.messages: exact unchanged question text as one user message in a fresh conversation; no system/history/examples/answer keys/tools/grammar

placement.policy: minimum CPU expert layers qualifying at shared context; all other layers GPU; embeddings GPU; fit off

grading.math: exact recursive JSON type/value/key/list-order equality; no numeric coercion
grading.code: unchanged extracted fenced solve(data); all hidden tests; policy compliance; no input mutation

outputs: deterministic correctness and separate strict-format result
elapsed inference time, usage, decode tokens/sec, finish reason
coding passed/total and first failing test index/reason
exact shared settings and actual per-model placement
coding_workflow: infer all questions; stop model; grade coding serially in Docker only; infrastructure errors stay unresolved rather than incorrect
future_paper_grading: Later LLM/reviewer assessment of reasoning and failure types is separate; criteria are not finalized. No LLM grading is implemented.
energy_collection: Not requested for cloud handoff; omit power/energy monitoring when porting.
status: No full 250-question model run collected. Existing pilot/smoke excluded from study.
